manifest_title: Source Specification / Feasibility Manifest — NOT YET ACCREDITED

scene_identity_evidence_audit.raster_headers: No acquisition timestamps, no orbit numbers, no SAFE product identifiers present in GeoTIFF tags (stripped during author patch extraction).
scene_identity_evidence_audit.zenodo_records: Zenodo records 8346860, 8253899, 13761290 contain only sequential patch filenames (00001 to 01200) without scene-to-SAFE cross-reference tables.
scene_identity_evidence_audit.companion_literature: Trujillo-Acatitla et al. (Marine Pollution Bulletin 2024, 204:116549) describes methodology but provides no per-patch SAFE product mapping index.
scene_identity_evidence_audit.cdse_stac_search: Spatial search over target footprint [30.6251° E, 32.0856° N, 30.8091° E, 32.2696° N] in collection 'sentinel-1-grd' returns multiple candidates (7 distinct S1A products in April 2024 alone; hundreds across 2015-2024).
scene_identity_evidence_audit.gating_rule: Section 4 strictly forbids arbitrary product selection or date guessing. If exact authoritative T0/T1 timestamps cannot be established, STOP HISTORICAL INTEGRATION HERE.

governance_and_integrity_invariants.double_counting_prohibition: CMEMS current velocity and ERA5 wind velocity drive the same drift trajectory equation. They share cluster 'DRIFT_METOCEAN_FORCING_CLUSTER' and must never be counted as two independent corroborating lines of evidence in Evidence Fusion.
governance_and_integrity_invariants.modelled_vs_observed_distinction: CMEMS and ERA5 are numerical reanalysis model assimilations. They are labelled 'HISTORICAL_REANALYSIS' or 'MODELLED_FORCING', never 'OBSERVED'.
governance_and_integrity_invariants.aggregated_ais_distinction: GFW hourly presence is labelled 'AGGREGATED_AIS_PRESENCE', never 'RAW_AIS_TELEMETRY'.
governance_and_integrity_invariants.negative_proof_guard: Absence of AIS in provider results never implies vessel absence (AIS_ABSENCE_IS_NOT_VESSEL_ABSENCE).
governance_and_integrity_invariants.synthetic_downstream_retention: Because Gate 0 halts external historical download, downstream drift and AIS artifacts in scenario TRUJILLO_00007_01339 remain SYNTHETIC_DEMO. Overall scenario provenance remains PROVENANCE_LIMITED.
